transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started on tomorrow's access coordination huddle. Under the normal access plan, all three would come through Gate 1 and stage on the North Apron with routine visitor sign-in at the gate. Before I approve the plan, I need the security, facilities, and medical-logistics representatives to confirm their updates. Who's ready to go first?
